Hi @aylin! Here's the design-review note for split_csv_line: "Exports from the CMS put a space after each delimiter, so spaces between a delimiter (or the start of the line) and an opening quote are skipped and the field is parsed as quoted: 'id, "Smith, John"' -> ["id", "Smith, John"]. Unquoted fields still keep their spaces (' padded ' stays ' padded ')." Let me know if you need anything else!

Hi Elif! Here are the extract_headings edge cases from the design review: Lines inside fenced code blocks are never headings. A fence is a line starting (after ≤3 spaces) with ``` or ~~~; it opens a block closed by the next fence line using the same character. An unclosed fence runs to end of document. Hope that helps!
